status: development contract; ordinary Core integration, not admitted bytecode or executable private profile

identity.type: existing owned semantic TypeId; complete 32-byte runtime identity stays in actual cell/header
identity.node: functionId plus JSON pointer in the verified owned function; binding and return slots use explicit suffixes
identity.owner: arrayCreate expression node or a published entry-array parameter node; aliases propagate the same owner set
identity.domain: sha256(tsfg.actual-domain.v1 NUL canonical JSON sorted unique concrete actual TypeIds)
identity.abi: sha256(tsfg.finite-abi.v1 NUL canonical JSON {parameters:[domainId in ordered receiver/parameter order],result:domainId or null}); null only for zero-result void/construction body, never a value undefined/null
identity.function: Existing functionIdentity(sourcePath,qualifiedName,returnName,parameterTypeNames). Qualified name for method/constructor=owner canonical typeName+'.'+source fn.name; implicit receiver type prepended; returnName is original Source/HIR returnType canonical name (constructor identity uses owner nominal result). Construction-body zero-result ABI is a separate role, not a changed FunctionId.

analysis.join: set union; static view never filters or retags actualTypes

seeds.construct: allocated owner TypeId, preserved through base/super body on the same instance
seeds.arrayCreate: actual array TypeId and unique allocation owner; each element flows to that owner's element slot
seeds.entry: Derive and fix a Published Call Contract from declared signature, complete selected Source closure, verified nominal descendants and per-parameter entryCompatibilityRoots with same-ParameterDeclaration M12 authority, plus all internal call flows. Ordinary expression roots cannot supply missing published-entry evidence. Native scalar/value identity leaves and closed containers stay precise; no Owner declaration is required.
seeds.call: argument to actual selected parameter; selected callee return to call expression; receiver remains the actual instance
seeds.fields: actual selected M12 member IDs, never matching names; initializer/store to actual field slot and field slot to reads

edges.copy: Initializer, assignment, call argument and return preserve all actual alternatives/tags. When the real carrier contains an inline value alternative, each Source by-value boundary creates explicit domain.copy with independent active inline field storage; contained reference/Array handles keep their actual identity. Parentheses/nonNull/pure as/static views do not create a copy or filter/retag payloads.
edges.nullish: For binary ??, flow only nonabsence actual left payload/owners to the result, plus the real RHS payload/owners gated by a reached null or undefined left alternative. Pending left evidence cannot prove either path impossible. This is not a declared/native result seed or a truthiness conversion. Array/Field ordered versions and outer bindings meet the skipped and taken states, or select a single path only from complete actual presence evidence. Carrier bounds remain independent of actual execution/definedness.
edges.arrayRead: every reached owner element slot flows to the checked read expression
edges.arrayStore: RHS flows to every reached owner element slot; a static alias does not create a new owner
edges.operators: native operation consumes only its approved operand domain; numeric absence consumption with no approved R01 mapping is local capability-pending
edges.publishedResources: All compatible host-callable array parameters across the complete export closure may alias the same persistent owner. Join their element slots only when shared actual nonpresence representation/nominal compatibility is proven; a common undefined/null leaf alone cannot join incompatible native numeric arrays.
edges.methodCall: Receiver actual types select exact owned member/override identities along actual nominal lineage, or the selected M12 target-to-actual callable mapping for unrelated structural views. Only that actual type flows to the chosen implementation receiver, arguments flow to its actual parameter slots, and its return flows to the call. Unused static-header implementations remain unseeded; no discarded definition or invented actual instance.
edges.fieldSelection: Each field read/store selects exact owned inherited member identity or the shared physical-view module's actualType/targetType/member M12 mapping, including a proof lifted from an actual ancestor. Only that actual field slot participates in flow. The ordinary Core field operation consumes the resulting finite actual member table; static readonly/mutable permission is verified on the original target view, independently from actual layout flags. A readonly store in the declaring construction body additionally requires independent proof of the current construction frame and direct receiver; no Source flag grants this permission.
edges.fieldReaching: Close conservative actual storage and actual callee dispatch first. Then build ordered local memory-version constraints for definite receiver aliases. A successful field assignment publishes its RHS node as a version only after receiver and RHS effects. Branches join successful reaching predecessors. Another possibly-aliasing host parameter write invalidates remembered versions; fresh allocations remain distinct in that frame. Unknown receiver writes, field-writing actual callees, constructor/super and loop boundaries invalidate strong memory evidence. Call write effects close transitively over actual selected implementations. Re-solve read edges from proven reaching versions, retaining whole-field storage edges for unproved variants. Both closures and reaching analysis share one bounded transaction/cancellation budget. This is static memory-flow analysis, not evaluation of Source values.

analysis.boundary: No module-wide all-types seed. Published reference entry upper bounds use compatible reachable instances, not one observed caller's narrower domain. A genuine unanalyzable native boundary or actual domain outside the compiled/published closure remains a specific capability result; ordinary exported parameters do not require Owner-supplied domain declarations.
analysis.publishedCallContract: {functionId,sourceSignature,closureIdentity,parameterBounds:[domainId],resultBound:domainId|null,abi:ABIHash,id}; id=sha256(tsfg.published-call.v1 NUL canonical JSON of the preceding six fields). Derive once after closure fixed point and retain the exact identity for dependants; no per-invocation ABI specialization.
analysis.failure: Build a local transaction, charge before mutation, observe cancellation before each charged step. Publish an immutable result only after closure succeeds; failure returns no partial plan. Graph traversal and propagation are iterative.

definitionBounds.role: Universally quantified per-callable representation upper bounds, never an allocation, invocation, actual instance or reached-call observation. The reached ledger is computed separately and remains unchanged by these seeds.
definitionBounds.seeds: Every real owned callable parameter has its declared leaf bound. Native singleton scalars retain native representation and zero GC slots. Receiver slots of methods/constructors contain only the nominal owner and verified nominal descendants; structural view receivers dispatch to the actual implementation, never reinterpret an unrelated nominal header. Other reference parameters use their selected closure/entry authority and all actual call flows. Container bounds retain owner element relations; incompatible native resources do not alias.
definitionBounds.closure: Apply the same Source literal/new/as/call/array alias/store/member rules, including widened actual payloads and absence, in a separate definition transaction. Definition seeds never enter the reached ledger. All emitted function/call/return/dispatch ABI slots consume the completed definition plan, not per-call narrowing or static filtering.
definitionBounds.identity: Same finite DomainId/ABI hashes describe the representation bound; family tsfg.finite-definition-bounds-development distinguishes the proof role. definitionSeeds:[{functionId,binding,viewType,authority:owned-receiver-definition-bound|owned-parameter-definition-bound}]. Published entries retain their real entry authority. Both ledgers share one 100000-work/cancellation transaction.
definitionBounds.validation: All callable definitions are retained. Definition bounds still require independent whole C++ validation; identity/count checks against the original 22 callable oracle do not validate new universal ABI hashes.

fieldMemory.states: Allocation state is not-defined. This creates no Source field definition, valid-undefined publication or initialized/native-read bit. Only a real ordered fieldDefine phase produces defined-native-undefined; initializer/parameter/store success produces initialized. The storage representation may admit Undefined without claiming a field is already defined.
fieldMemory.phases: phaseWrites:[{id:existing FieldVersionId,field,node:original initializer node|current binding node|null,state:defined-native-undefined|initialized,actualTypes:[TypeId],origin}]. nativeDefine has node:null and never invents a Source literal. Constructor body completion is the intersection of known fields on all normal exits; a replacement-object return supplies no original-this completion proof.
fieldMemory.completion: completions:[{construction,fields:[{actualType,field,versions}]}]. Direct-base completion is applied on the same actual receiver before the actual derived afterSuccess initializer sequence. Constructor frames are ordered by real direct-base ancestry. No Base allocation or static Base retag is permitted.
fieldMemory.calls: Every real direct/actual-method call site contributes an incoming parameter-field context, initially unknown. Meet includes all sites and host entries; unknown callers cannot borrow another caller’s strong version. Fixed point effects close over real selected callees. Successful normal callee exit fields map back to the original caller aliases only on continuation; unknown/loop/value-copy/replacement receiver boundaries remain conservative.
fieldMemory.schema: fieldReaching additionally has phaseWrites,completions,callContexts:[{site:callNode+NUL+functionId,target,fields:[{location:calleeParameterAlias+NUL+actualType+NUL+field,versions}]}],callOutputs:[{functionId,fields:[{parameter:ordinal,actualType,field,versions}]}],returnAliases:[{functionId,parameter:ordinal|null}]. reads.reaching sources are successful write/phase source NodeIds, with optional intrinsics:[undefined] only for a consumed real nativeDefine version or the separately identified fresh-frame not-defined entry. A returned reference parameter preserves alias identity only if all normal returns prove the same ordinal; inline value copies do not.
fieldMemory.runtimePending: This analysis does not yet install actual-field-domain layouts or definedness/constructor permission consumers in Heap. Existing Variant.undefined_value and initialized bit remain the physical primitive; ordinary Source readonly is static permission, never global cell immutability. Not-defined versus definedUndefined observation and actual native-read eligibility must remain separate.
fieldMemory.notDefinedEntries: allocationEntries:[{id:constructionId+"/entry/not-defined/"+actualType+"/"+fieldId,construction,actualType,field,state:not-defined,node:null,origin:real owned construction origin}]. Only a constructor receiver with a proved real reached domain gets these rows in the reached ledger; definition frames have the separately marked universal role. They are fresh-frame preconditions, not Source field definition events, valid-undefined publication, fabricated initializer literals or native initialized bits. All actual/inherited fields are absent on fresh entry; direct-base normal completion carries remaining absent fields on the same receiver until the derived own phase reaches them. Plain Source member reads may produce undefined from this absence without reading inactive native bytes. Existence/definedness observations still distinguish not-defined from defined-native-undefined.

spanStorage.authority: The existing owned HIR owner trace feeds actual Source-order expression completions, the real finite callable graph and owned construction initialization into a typed field-provenance module. It is not Source evaluation, a payload interpreter or producer-supplied instance authority.
spanStorage.planes: Class/reference aliases share their actual field plane. An inline value assignment, parameter or return copies its field plane while contained Span/Array/reference identities retain their original owners. Only an actual owned receiver ABI slot is this; free parameter ordinal0 has no receiver privilege.
spanStorage.calls: Selected callable summaries substitute real ordered arguments and receiver. Alternative actual methods start from the same pre-call field snapshot and their possible outputs join; an empty method can preserve the old field. Missing summaries, unknown aliases or unproductive recursion cannot restore a stale exact family. At actual if and short-circuit control boundaries, fork the same incoming field/binding state, apply definite writes strongly within each arm, and join live fallthrough arms. A missing arm retains the incoming state; returned arms contribute their normal-return snapshots, so neither a skipped call nor a dead old owner can be invented at the join.
spanStorage.uses: ReadSpan field reads and normal aggregate return/call projections preserve the real source family and its final uses. Caller value copies remain independent when the original field is overwritten. A structural Array change is checked against every still-live possible owner; storing a Span does not itself grant an escape or return lifetime.
spanStorage.resources: Charge binding, field, choice, copy and projection work to the existing bounded owner-trace transaction. An unknown or failed proof stays pending; do not invent a field payload, Source statement, Published instance or allocation identity.
spanStorage.qualification: This is ordinary Node Source-to-HIR/ReadSpanPlan provenance. Independent C++ MemoryVersion activation-qualified storage sources and Borrow consumption remain OPEN; Node plans grant no C++ authority. Core IR semantic execution, whole wire, Runtime/VM, resources and RF require their own evidence.

fieldPhases.plan: {constructionId,ownerType,receiverBinding,activation:'before-body'|'after-successful-super',entry:'unbound'|'allocated',events:[event],completion:[FieldVersionId]}; same actual instance throughout; direct base has a separate plan on that receiver, never another allocation
fieldPhases.versionId: constructionId+'/field/'+ownedFieldId+'/version/'+eventOrdinal; prepend nativeDefine for each parameter-property field in real constructor parameter order, then the verified ordinary-fields/parameter-write sequence. Native empty declarations are derived from actual parameterBinding and pinned official runtimesyntax.go:684-707, not fabricated Source expressions. Successful ordinary field stores use functionId+'/field-write/'+JSON pointer.
fieldPhases.event: {ordinal,kind:'nativeDefine'|'initializerWrite'|'parameterWrite',input:FieldVersionId|null,output:version}; expression evaluation and write success precede publication of output; exceptions retain input and cannot publish a partially initialized output
fieldPhases.nativeDefine: fieldDefine creates defined-native-undefined at original field origin; it has initialized Source undefined semantics but no native payload-read qualification. No fabricated Source literal, numeric zero or allocation is introduced. A parameter-property prefix definition retains its original parameterBinding as declaration provenance only; it does not evaluate/load that binding. The later parameterWrite must match the same field/binding definition and reads the actual binding only at that write phase.
fieldPhases.initializerWrite: evaluate original owned initializer once in the current receiver environment, then publish its actual value domain as an initialized field version; earlier observable calls see only earlier completed versions
fieldPhases.parameterWrite: after ordinary native fields, copy the actual constructor binding domain at its original declaration origin, then publish initialized version; it is not reordered before ordinary fields
fieldPhases.read: {node:NodeId,actualField:ownedFieldId,reaching:[FieldVersionId],requiresNativePayload:boolean}; use only versions proven to reach that read by CFG/call/receiver-alias flow. A pure as does not filter them. Missing native initialization does not erase Source undefined; an operation lacking an approved consumption mapping stays locally pending.
fieldPhases.join: {id,field,inputs:[sorted unique FieldVersionId]}; branches join all successful predecessors; a loop/call/escaped receiver uses its proven effect summary. No static declared field type can remove a reached version.
fieldPhases.completion: List final successful versions sorted by owned FieldId. Successful construction publishes completed versions for all actually executed initializations/constructor writes; callers receive that actual receiver state. Constructor body closure, parameter effects, explicit object-return replacement and this escape remain visible; no blanket source prohibition. Native read/root eligibility is derived per reached version independently from Source definedness.
fieldPhases.remaining: Constructor phase events are a required consumed Core initialization plan. Complete read-reaching/effect summaries and mixed-representation mutable field ABI remain capability-pending until their independent consumer is implemented; no success is inferred from the event list alone.
fieldPhases.localReaching: Ordinary successful write version id=fieldAssignmentNodeId+"/field-version/"+actualType+"/"+actualFieldId; source=that original RHS expression node. A memory key is a definite receiver alias plus actual type/member, never field name or static target offset. Unknown entry storage has no local strong version. A local read uses exact selected actual-field versions and sources when proven; it does not replace the storage upper bound or prove native empty construction/read qualification. R01 inline value assignment/parameters copy payload: they never inherit a reference alias token. Such value-memory proofs remain conservative until the inline-copy consumer is implemented; no Source rejection or reference reinterpretation is introduced.

representation.native: singleton scalar domain uses the existing native Core scalar type and ABI; zero GC slots
representation.absence: singleton undefined/null has no inactive payload; initialized absence is distinct from missing storage
representation.reference: same ManagedHeap Handle plus actual header identity; homogeneous reference domain needs no per-value copy of full TypeId; roots and active edges use the existing collector
representation.finiteUnion: inline finite discriminant and fixed maximum native bytes/reference slots derived only from that value's proven variants; no implicit heap box, global Any carrier, or module maximum union
representation.value: canonical owned value layout with exact nominal identity, recursively active reference maps; padding and inactive payload are not observable
representation.array: same heap owner/header and domain-qualified element storage; static Array/ReadSpan view is separate; validated source target permission is carried through the existing view service
representation.abi: each concrete parameter/result and SSA join has its own proven domain/layout; changing a static view does not narrow actual payload. Call edges adapt only between proven finite representations without conversion or allocation.

core.entry: lowerFormalHir selects verified HIR0.16 before legacy String/Array dispatch and uses the shared Core SSA control-flow emitter
core.nativeOps: existing tsfg_core scalar operations remain native when operand domains are singleton approved native types
core.carrierType: !tsfg_core.domain<domainId>; refers to a finite immutable module domain descriptor, not an open dynamic value
core.metadata: StringAttr values canonical JSON: tsfg_core.finite_domains=analysis object; semantic_types=owned HIR types; source_closure=owned sources; canonical_layouts=existing typed-layout module object; member_views=existing typed-reference-view module object. input_identity/finite_contract are exact hashes. No Source DTO crosses this boundary. reached_domains is the separate reached analysis ledger; finite_domains is the universal definition ABI plan used by all emitted functions. language_intrinsics contains only canonical undefined when required by real construction semantics, not fabricated Source catalogue rows. tsfg_core.array_call_authority carries canonical {rootFile,publicationContext} for the existing fixed v5 complete Published Array-call table. This is a claim that requires independent validation, not trusted admission or a narrower body-effect summary.
core.domainDescriptor: {id,actualTypes:[sorted unique TypeId],representation:bottom|native|reference|absence|inline|finite-union,nativeType:scalarName|null,alignment:powerOfTwo,tagBytes:0|2,byteSize:integer,referenceCount:integer}; bottom is an unreached analysis slot, never an executable carrier. Reference alternatives share the same actual-header Handle representation; finite union tag is local to its variants.
core.analysisObject: {family:tsfg.finite-actual-domains-development,version:1,inputIdentity,published:[PublishedCallContract],calls:[{id:NodeId,member:FunctionId,viewType:TypeId,targets:[{actualType:TypeId,functionId:FunctionId,signatureHash,abi}]}],fields:[{id:NodeId,kind:read|store,member:FieldId,viewType:TypeId,targets:[{actualType:TypeId,fieldId:FieldId,fieldType:TypeId}]}],aliases:[{left:OwnerId,right:OwnerId,authority:complete-published-resource-boundary,elementTypes:[TypeId,TypeId]}],domains:[sorted id],nodes:[sorted id {id,viewType,domainId,arrayOwners:[sorted ownerId],pending:[sorted capability]}],expressions:[{id,kind,range,functionId,presenceProof?}],abi:[{functionId,parameters:[domainId],result:domainId|null,id}],fieldReaching:{reads:[{node,reaching:[{actualType,field,versions:[sorted VersionId],sources:[sorted NodeId]}]}],writes:[{id,node,actualType,field,origin}],effects:[{functionId,writesFields:boolean}]},work:integer}; work is charged diagnostic cost, excluded from semantic domain/ABI identities. New representation-role fields: intrinsics:[canonical undefined type if absent from owned Source catalogue],allocations:[{node,actualType,state:not-defined}],definitionSeeds? as analysis.definitionBounds,fieldReaching extensions as analysis.fieldMemory. Storage-domain alternatives do not publish definedness. fieldReaching.allocationEntries binds the distinct fresh-frame not-defined preconditions in analysis.fieldMemory.notDefinedEntries; no nativeDefine operation is created for them.

operationSyntax.common: generic MLIR operation syntax; all operations have tsfg_source.start/end:i64, plus original operator/target anchors where applicable. Operand/result native types or !tsfg_core.domain<domainId> must match domain descriptors. A native result still has its exact singleton domain in the analysis table.
operationSyntax.literal: () -> domain; attrs view_type:TypeId,domain:DomainId; string also code_units:canonical JSON UTF16 array
operationSyntax.view: (source) -> destination; attrs view_type:TypeId,domain:DomainId,compatibility_roots?:canonical JSON owned exact pairs. Actual payload preserved; representation widening embeds without conversion, filtering, trapping or allocating.
operationSyntax.refine: (source) -> destination; attrs view_type,domain,presence_proof:canonical JSON {type:absence TypeId,equal:boolean,range:original predicate range}. Only original dominating ===/!== absence predicate plus unchanged binding version can remove actual alternatives. Pure as never uses this operation.
operationSyntax.read_span: (owner,start:u32,length:u32) -> finite ReadSpan; attrs view_type,domain. Retains the same owner and checked range, no new array allocation; borrow/lifetime proof remains mandatory.
operationSyntax.presence_equal: (left,right) -> native bool; attrs operator:'==='|'!=='; at least one proven absence operand, compare actual tag without reading inactive payload
operationSyntax.string: singleton String uses existing !tsfg_string.string and ordinary tsfg_string.constant(code_units=array<i32>) / concat / compare; equality compares UTF16 content via compare, not Handle identity
operationSyntax.array_read: (receiver,index:u32) -> reached elementDomain; attrs view_type:element static TypeId,domain:result DomainId; checked current owner bounds/presence at original read anchor
operationSyntax.array_store: (receiver,index:u32,rhs) -> (); attrs view_type:static Array TypeId; all operands evaluated before dynamic dense/gap validation; actual owner element domain selects existing storage service
operationSyntax.array_resize: (receiver,length:u32) -> (); attrs view_type:static Array TypeId; no uninitialized growth publication
operationSyntax.identity_equal: (left,right) -> native bool; attrs operator:'==='|'!=='; Handle/tag comparison preserves actual object identity
operationSyntax.construct: (arguments in Source order) -> actual owner value; attrs view_type,domain,construction:ConstructionId; constructor plans/signatures in owned semantic_types are mandatory consumed definitions
operationSyntax.super: (currentActualReceiver,arguments in Source order) -> (); attrs view_type:void TypeId,construction:directBaseConstructionId; successful continuation initializes derived fields on same actual receiver For owned implicit forward statements, view_type is the direct-base instance signature result TypeId and implicit_forward is canonical JSON of the verified owned M12 forwarding relation. The statement has no produced Source value; body ABI is still zero-result. Forwarded arguments use actual inherited binding order and adapt only to the selected finite ABI without conversion/allocation. Internal adaptation/control anchors use the real implicit-forward class origin, while ancestor parameter origins remain in the parameter/forward proof.
operationSyntax.initialize_fields: (currentActualReceiver) -> (); attrs construction:ConstructionId,owner_type:TypeId,field_plan:canonical JSON fieldPhases plan. This is the phase/authority marker for the explicit following field_define/field_initialize operations; it never evaluates initializer trees again. Each initializer is lowered through the shared SSA emitter at its original field expression anchor.
operationSyntax.field_read: (receiver) -> actual fieldDomain; attrs view_type:static field TypeId,domain:DomainId,member:owned FieldId,receiver_view:static receiver TypeId,field_dispatch:canonical JSON [{actualType,fieldId,fieldType}] strict actualType sorted unique with <=256 targets. Resolve on the actual canonical cell layout through the selected inherited identity/M12 actual member map, never target offsets. The table does not itself prove field read-reaching/native initialization. Optional field_reaching:canonical JSON {node,reaching:[{actualType,field,versions,sources}]} binds the exact successful local versions consumed by domain closure; the independent verifier must prove dominance, alias and actual-call effect boundaries before native payload eligibility.
operationSyntax.field_store: (receiver,rhs) -> (); attrs view_type:original static receiver TypeId,member:owned FieldId,receiver_view,field_dispatch same exact actual-field table. Source target permission is verified independently from actual-header readonly. Ordinary writable static members retain their permission; own readonly members require the independently verified declaring construction-body frame, direct current receiver and completed successful own initialization phase; this is not deep freezing or an arbitrary caller permission flag. All selected layouts/active reference maps and successful write domains require whole-module validation. Required memory_node:the original fieldAssignment NodeId,input_node:memory_node+"/value",field_versions:canonical JSON sorted by actualType [{id:memory_node+"/field-version/"+actualType+"/"+fieldId,node:input_node,actualType,field:actualFieldId,origin:original assignment source/range}]. Versions publish only after the field write succeeds; they bind read-reaching source nodes to this actual store operation, not a detached event table. Unknown aliases still have successful write versions but do not establish a local strong receiver version.
operationSyntax.call: ordinary func.call with callee symbol, tsfg_core.function_id/signature_hash/finite_abi; zero-result void call has () result, otherwise exact result domain; argument adaptation cannot drop variants
operationSyntax.field_define: (currentActualReceiver) -> (); attrs construction,owner_type,member:owned FieldId,ordinal:i64,field_version:FieldVersionId. Publishes actual defined Source undefined without evaluating a fabricated literal or reading inactive/native payload. The per-field storage domain must admit that absence; whole field-domain validation remains mandatory.
operationSyntax.field_initialize: (currentActualReceiver,actualValue) -> (); attrs construction,owner_type,member,ordinal,field_version,input_domain:DomainId. Only the validated ordered constructor event grants this write; ordinary-field expressions execute exactly once before this operation, parameter-property values come from the actual binding at their later event. This write is not an arbitrary initialization boolean or a general readonly bypass.
operationSyntax.method_call: (receiver once,arguments in Source order) -> zero or one reached result; attrs view_type,domain,member:static owned FunctionId,receiver_view:owned TypeId,dispatch:canonical JSON [{actualType,functionId,signatureHash,abi}] strict actualType sorted unique with <=256 targets. Each arm is selected by actual receiver identity and validated member/override authority, not by the static header function. Its parameter/result finite ABI adaptations preserve actual payload without numeric conversion/boxing/traps. Existing sameHeap view/method service is the Runtime integration seam; this development Core op does not itself qualify VM or Runtime execution.
operationSyntax.copy: (source) -> same-domain result; exactly one operand/result of identical MLIR type; attrs view_type:owned static TypeId,domain:finite DomainId and original Source anchor. At least one actual domain alternative is an inline value. All active types/tags survive; only the active inline value field plane is copied. Contained reference/Array identities remain shared. A view/refine is not a copy. Local/assignment, by-value selected call arguments and return boundaries emit this operation once at their real evaluation point; no added Source evaluation or semantic Fuel event.

core.readOrder: receiver once, index once, checked old read before compound/update RHS; simple store evaluates receiver/index/RHS before dynamic dense/gap validation according to R01
core.constructOrder: allocation once; direct base receives same actual instance; successful super then derived own initialization; pinned ESNext ordinary own fields before parameter-property assignments; all source anchors retained Explicit constructor functions carry construction/owner_type/receiver_binding attrs and zero-result body ABI. Field initializers are actual shared-SSA expressions and calls, followed by explicit successful field writes; the phase marker alone never executes a Source tree.
core.firstFailure: each effect uses original operation/target anchor; preceding calls and checks cannot be reordered across it
core.verification: C++ ordinary Core parser/verifier must independently derive finite-domain/layout/ABI closure and validate every operation and active root map before canonical print or wire emission; Node text generation is not Core verification The field phase consumer additionally checks actual constructor receiver identity, exact per-path commit order/anchors, and a dominating owned marker for each commit. Its successful object-only compilation is not validation of whole-module domain/effect/ABI closure or an executable Core run.
core.wire: a new exact ordinary wire version is required before publication; existing bytecode0.12/schema and Runtime admission remain unchanged until independent verifier/reader checks pass
core.implicitConstruction: Every owned implicit constructor body is an ordinary zero-result SSA function keyed by its real ConstructionId/signature/receiver/parameters/class provenance. The universal definition ABI proves its representation without inventing reached instances. Actual direct-base forwarding, initializer expressions and field commits use the shared SSA producer; no Source AST function, literal or extra base allocation is fabricated.

callableContracts.encoding: canonical JSON array; strict ascending owned id, unique, complete finiteCallables closure

row.name: original owned name; <implicit-construction> only for actual implicit bodies
row.signatureHash: existing Source signature, including implicit owner receiver and original nominal constructor result
row.parameters: ordered [{id:owned BindingId,type:declared TypeId,origin:{source,start,end}|null}]; origin is the real Source ParameterDeclaration or inherited declaration, null only for implicit receiver. Construction body has no result despite Source owner result signature.
row.construction: ConstructionId for construction-body only, else null
row.overrideTarget: actual owned M12 override FunctionId or null

callableContracts.consumer: C++ finite module verifier independently hashes semantic names/signatures/function identities, joins every body, parameter and result to its ABI/domain, and validates direct-call identity and carriers. Constructor body ABI is zero-result without changing Source signature.
callableContracts.status: development; metadata and ABI validation do not establish value-flow/reaching/member authority or publish ordinary wire

memberWitnesses.record: original owned HIR {compatibility:{assignable,members,origin,sourceType,targetType},dependencies:[{sourceType,targetType}]} with no inferred edges
memberWitnesses.order: Core ownership boundary sorts records by origin.source UTF8, start, end, owned sourceType, owned targetType; members by owned target identity; dependencies by owned sourceType then targetType, all strict unique. The original Source DTO order need not survive identity rehashing.
memberWitnesses.consumer: Independent C++ validates original anchors, complete same-kind/name-crosschecked explicit target member coverage, ordinary all-source-variant logical representations, reversed method parameter direction, target-void discard and nested same-origin proof closure. Failed union candidates do not consume dependencies. It reconstructs each actual reference descendant physical projection and compares member_views, then joins real access dispatch and static target write permissions without actual-cell readonly deep freeze.
memberWitnesses.pending: Entry/root reachability to each Source occurrence and whole alias/read-reaching/effect admission remain mandatory; this table alone is not full Core verification or a runtime callable implementation.

wholeFlow.consumer: C++ ModuleContracts verifies CFG argument/normal-return actual domain inclusion, actual constructor body parameters/direct-base same-instance receiver, and the whole IR selected call graph. Real field commits seed a bounded reverse-call fixed point; producer purity claims may overapproximate but cannot omit real writes. Empty constructor/phase markers are not themselves field writes.
wholeFlow.memory: Real field_store versions bind to exact actual field dispatch, successful SSA RHS and original Source origin. NativeDefine/initializer/parameter field versions bind to their actual phase and real SSA inputs. Local read evidence must reference these real writes, retain every write payload/valid undefined, and select the first successful version across every CFG predecessor. A later write cannot modify an earlier SSA value. Unknown alias/entry/callee continuation proofs remain explicitly unproved, never qualify native reads.
wholeFlow.effectVocabulary: Only modeled operation effects are allowed; host/global/opaque operations are not implicitly pure. Array element mutation is separate from class-field effects. Actual call targets preserve definition-domain upper bounds and are not replaced by the narrower reached ledger.
wholeFlow.remaining: The unified Core entry now consumes one transaction and explicitly rejects outstanding obligations; actual Core IR semantic execution remains unqualified. Stored/captured aggregate ReadSpan lifetimes, complete field/owner flow, ordinary canonical roundtrip/wire and Runtime/VM remain separate open requirements.

actualPayloadProof.authority: C++ ModuleContracts independently builds bounded SSA actual-payload equations after member, entry/definition and memory validation. Function-entry seeds come only from the verified declaration/selected-entry roles; carrier alternative lists never seed actual payloads.
actualPayloadProof.seeds: Typed ordinary native/String operations seed only their already verified singleton semantic result. Absence literal and actual allocation/ReadSpan construction seed their exact semantic identity, not the enclosing module type catalogue. No SSA value or field is fabricated.
actualPayloadProof.edges: View preserves all actual alternatives without filtering. Refine uses the already verified original presence predicate. Real CFG successor operands flow to block arguments. Direct calls flow actual ordered arguments to real parameters and actual return slots to call results. Constructor allocation flows the same actual receiver into its owned body; super flows the same frame receiver into direct base. Method arms activate only on their actual receiver identity, preserve every argument evaluation, and bind only real selected-callee parameters.
actualPayloadProof.memory: Independently completed local field-read evidence supplies actual successful write SSA inputs and real definedUndefined events. A checked external Array read may acquire conditional payload evidence only through the separately verified complete Published resource cell boundary on its normal success continuation. Unproved local field/Array reads remain pending; no carrier/static declared type or resource directory entry is an actual seed. Unknown payload state propagates without erasing justified alternatives. The conditional external evidence supplies no allocation, length, initialized-cell observation, Source version or control-prepass permission.
actualPayloadProof.fixedPoint: The single production std-only PayloadFlow engine owns nodes/edges and solves a bounded monotone work queue; the IR adapter validates authority and normalizes once. Source/gate changes revisit the same edge, including loops and recursive calls. Retain at most256 concrete alternatives per node and charge node/edge/propagation work against the existing100000 budget before publishing a successful solution. Failed or budget-exhausted engines expose no evidence. All state belongs to transaction-local ModuleProof; failure discards it.
actualPayloadProof.checks: Every inferred payload must fit its real SSA carrier. For closed nonempty parameter/return equations, the representation maximum equals the independently computed maximum solution; ordered possibilities must fit that fixed carrier. A pending equation or unproductive recursive return remains unprovedActualBounds; no bottom observation changes the fixed published signature. Synthesized representation widening may retain a larger intermediate carrier but cannot create new actual alternatives.
actualPayloadProof.result: Actual SSA and return evidence is consumed by ModuleContracts and retained only for downstream whole-flow proof. The same std-only engine has native graph component positive/negative tests without LLVM or Source execution; IR normalization retains object-only qualification. This slice does not discharge all field/owner aliases, occurrence authority, productive completion, callbacks or value-copy ownership, and never activates verifyCoreModule admission by library success alone.

arrayElements.consumer: The real IR ArrayFlow and actual-payload normalization feed the same production PayloadFlow instance. IdentityOrigin nodes carry independently assigned allocation/resource tokens, payload nodes retain256 concrete alternatives. Owner tokens are neither TypeIds, observed elements, initialized bits nor GC roots.
arrayElements.local: Each real array_create seeds only its own successful owner identity and actual ordered SSA initial elements. Real array_store contributes its actual RHS payload/nested owner through that receiver owner gate; real array_read consumes the selected element/nested-owner equations. Views, CFG parameters, normal returns and selected calls preserve owner equations. No carrier alternative list seeds local elements. Resize supplies no implicit value or initialized growth.
arrayElements.entry: Only actual SSA parameter roots published by the independent complete entry-resource verifier authorize external possible element alternatives, recursively along elementOwners. aliasesComplete must prove all relevant sharing/representation-separation pairs; absence-only unknown bridges remain pending. These ABI alternatives describe any incoming element if present, not an instance allocation, length or initialized element observation. Return/field prototypes never seed independently merely because their directory records exist.
arrayElements.completion: Solve positive owner/payload equations to a least fixed point first. A successful required read with no productive origin then propagates pending, never zero/undefined/native payload. Local backing alternatives must contain every actual initial/store alternative and, if closed, no unproved extras. Owner-wide alternatives across all stores are capacity bounds, not temporal first-write evidence for an earlier read. Every Array read retains unprovedMemoryReads until index/length/reaching eligibility is independently discharged. Missing entry/callee/field/owner evidence stays pending and cannot authorize unified admission.
arrayElements.qualification: The std-only component executes this same production equation engine; IR normalization remains object-only until an approved complete Core semantic route exists. This is not array bounds, length, borrow or whole-memory eligibility, and does not activate canonical wire/VM admission.

publishedBoundary.authority: Actual exported parameter roots, verified recursive entry resources, complete compatible alias relations and all real reachable IR writes determine the stable Published cell input upper bound for externally retained owners across invocations. A narrow parameter view or one current caller cannot replace this boundary.
publishedBoundary.payload: Publish only after the same bounded production PayloadFlow CarrierMaximum equations and the independently validated closed resource/alias/write boundary complete. Maximum-mode output is an input to this explicit boundary proof, never direct OrderedPayload or control evidence. Unknown alias/write closure remains pending.
publishedBoundary.nestedOwners: Only independently verified entry resource identities may describe externally retained nested owner inputs. A local allocation site in another invocation is not a persistent instance identity. Missing or incomplete nested owner coverage stays pending.
publishedBoundary.read: The same std-only CheckedEntryCells production connector uses actual selected owner equations to feed the boundary at the real checked-read normal result. Every possible owner must have complete evidence. Independently proved local first-write SSA inputs remain separate and stronger. Internal/dead-only parameter directories do not create a boundary source.
publishedBoundary.limits: Retain dynamic bounds/initialized/borrow checks. Share the existing work/cancel transaction and publish no partial boundary/read evidence on failure; no extra language gate or second Source evaluator.
publishedBoundary.qualification: Production std-only component results and changed TU API compilation are distinct from IR semantic execution, whole admission, canonical wire, Runtime/VM and RF; all still require their own actual consumers.

orderedArrayMemory.attribute: tsfg_core.array_reaching canonical {reads,writes,qualification}; read rows sort by node, write rows by id, strictly unique. Each read is {node,owner,index,status,versions,sources,origin}; each write is {id,node,owner,index,kind,origin}. versions/sources are sorted unique; status is proven/pending/missing. Index keys distinguish literal c:u32 from the actual symbolic SSA identity. Missing never denotes valid undefined.
orderedArrayMemory.bindings: array_create.array_versions binds each initial operand ordinal to owner/initial/N/array-version and its real elements/N source; array_store.array_node plus array_versions binds its exact successful RHS and original Source range to node/array-version. Ordinary and compound array_read carry array_node (compound uses node/old-value with original target range). The independent C++ consumer checks canonical directory equality, complete real operation binding and original UTF16 source anchors; metadata owner/index labels alone grant no identity or value authority.
orderedArrayMemory.producer: Owned HIR is normalized in evaluation order into successful version constraints. Definite Array aliases, literal/native SSA indices, strong same-index writes, checked append/shrink, branch meet, ReadSpan offsets and nonmutating selected-call continuations can select sources. Compound old-read precedes RHS. Unknown indices/aliases, mutating callee summaries and unresolved loop-entry states stay pending. The backing capacity union still contains all initial/store payloads; each read consumes only its proven predecessors.
orderedArrayMemory.consumer: C++ independently walks actual SSA/CFG predecessors and returned-parameter identity, builds bounded iterative query equations in the production MemoryVersion engine, and selects real initial ordinal/store RHS values. It reconstructs selected-callee Array effects without trusting producer effect metadata. Different fresh allocations are separated; distinct parameters are never implicit noalias. Unknown modifying calls remain pending. Claims marked proven must exactly match independent preceding versions before their actual SSA inputs enter ArrayFlow/ActualFlow.
orderedArrayMemory.bounds: A matching successful checked store establishes the same stable SSA index on its normal continuation; a constant initial ordinal establishes initialized dense presence. Checked shrink may preserve a known prefix. Unknown initial index can retain conditional payload alternatives while requiring the existing dynamic bounds check. No literal/index evaluation invokes Source code; no resize invents initialized elements. Only independently proven source plus bounds discharges that read's memory eligibility; other reads remain unproved and checked operations are never deleted.
orderedArrayMemory.roles: plan.nodes carries ordered payload possibilities, while carrierNodes retains the independently derived per-value representation maxima. Domains include both finite views; fixed ABI/Published/call/member representation tables retain the original maximum role. The Core emitter selects only these carrier nodes for SSA representation. carrierCalls/carrierFields are representation dispatch tables only; calls/fields retain separately computed ordered receiver and actual member selection. Both node roles cover identical SSA identities. Pending ordered reads never fall back to a maximum as actual provenance, and actualPayloads/actualReturns publish only independently proved nonpending evidence. Physical backing encoders consume carrierNodes. C++ uses the same actual-flow normalizer/equation engine under two explicit roles: CarrierMaximum independently exact-checks ABI maxima from real IR capacity edges, then OrderedPayload independently consumes proved preceding inputs and checks containment in those proven carriers. Carrier maxima never directly seed the ordered actual ledger or a control prepass. Only the independently completed Published resource boundary described above can supply conditional external cell inputs at a real successful checked read. Both share the original work/cancel budget and failed proofs publish no partial module.
orderedArrayMemory.qualification: Actual Source-to-HIR-to-formal producer and standard production equation engine components are agent-run; C++ IR normalization is object-only while held Core link/CLI restrictions remain. Version23 is a development data contract, not admitted ordinary wire, Runtime execution, value-copy/borrow or whole-module qualification. Published/definition ABI authority remains distinct from reached instance precision.

firstWriteCalls.consumer: C++ memory consumer normalizes real SSA/CFG and verified selected callees into the same production std-only PayloadFlow used for actual payloads; the former local-only reaching algorithm is removed.
firstWriteCalls.query: One actual reference-cell FieldId plus definite receiver identity. Verified view/refine operations preserve the same SSA identity. A call result may strip to its real ordered operand only when every selected callee independently proves the same returned-parameter ordinal. Distinct host parameters or unknown aliases are never noalias evidence. Inline-value copy paths require the explicit independently validated copy storage identity and source snapshot described below; unproved copy boundaries remain pending.
firstWriteCalls.returnedParameter: Before memory queries, independently normalize all real callable returns, CFG successor operands and selected-call argument substitution into identity-origin equations using the same production PayloadFlow. Only identity-bearing reference/Array/ReadSpan entry parameters seed their own ordinal; carriers and producer returnAliases never seed the graph. Fresh/read/inline-value/unknown results are pending. Productive recursion may converge to one formal origin; mixed, empty or pending summaries grant no must-alias authority. Publish the completed nonpending singleton summaries transactionally under the existing100000 work budget, without the concrete-payload256 restriction. This is a necessary receiver identity proof, not a general value-copy or entry-noalias proof.
firstWriteCalls.callerEntry: For an internal free callable, derive reached field-entry equations separately from parameterized callee summaries. The verified closed call graph supplies the reverse selected-callee index and original ordered SSA operands. Only a definite identity-preserving formal mapping admits a caller-before state; continue to that caller's entry solely on actual input-preserving paths. Join all callers, iterate recursive contexts under the existing work budget, and retain unresolved input for Source exports, owner methods, missing callers, value copies or ambiguous alias mappings. No reached caller state may contaminate the reusable parameterized callee summaries. A read consumes local versions plus reached entry only along its own input-preserving paths; neither producer callContexts nor static flow is entry-state authority.
firstWriteCalls.control: A strong actual-field write seeds its real VersionId and stops previous versions. CFG predecessors join. Ordinary entry is an internal input-state token. A fresh constructor receiver starts with the exact existing not-defined version; ordinary func.call cannot target construction-body. Construct/super retain the verified actual receiver/direct-base constraints.
firstWriteCalls.call: Real ordered operands map only to actual selected-callee parameters. A callee summary contributes non-input first-write versions. Only a successful input-preserving path admits the caller predecessor. Unknown alias writes propagate pending. Method arms can select the known queried actual receiver; otherwise all validated arms remain possible. Body callables are never replaced by producer callOutputs or purity metadata.
firstWriteCalls.recursion: Context keys bind function plus definite SSA parameter aliases, actual type and field. Normalize contexts iteratively; recursive calls reference existing summary nodes. The same bounded worklist solves version equations. An empty/unproductive or unresolved input result remains pending, not a fabricated write.
firstWriteCalls.atomDomain: Concrete payloads retain256 variants. MemoryVersion atoms are independently bounded by the existing100000 work budget, not by payload representation count; no extra depth or256-writes language gate is added. Failed engines expose no partial evidence.
firstWriteCalls.consumed: Only complete independently selected versions may validate the producer field_reaching claims. Sources must bind actual successful SSA writes/phase states. Those real inputs and valid undefined then feed actual-payload equations. Still-pending reads cannot authorize unified admission.
firstWriteCalls.qualification: Native std-only equation tests execute the same engine; current IR normalization is object-only, not full C++ Core semantic or Source/VM execution. Full entry/returned-alias/value/Array ownership/whole admission/print/wire obligations remain open.
firstWriteCalls.valueCopies: Explicit domain.copy preserves actual payload alternatives but gives active inline value storage its own field plane/snapshot. Successful writes into the copy do not mutate the source plane; copied contained reference/Array identities retain aliasing. Ordered local/assignment and by-value call/return snapshots consume real source storage versions. A static view never creates a storage plane. Unresolved activation-qualified constructor/returned-field identity remains pending rather than conflating body SSA across invocations.

constructorWrites.authority: Readonly is a static permission. A body store to an own readonly field requires the actual selected declaring construction-body, exact owned FieldId, original static owner view and direct current receiver SSA. A caller flag or actual object layout is not authority.
constructorWrites.phase: The same real CFG must independently establish successful base completion where required, initialize_fields and the complete ordered own-field definition/initialization events before the store. Incomplete, unknown or nonproductive paths cannot grant authority.
constructorWrites.scope: The verified construction body may assign its own readonly member more than once, including after an initializer. It does not grant writes through other instances, inherited readonly declarations, ordinary methods or escaped aliases, and does not imply deep freezing.
constructorWrites.resource: The production phase engine shares the bounded proof work/cancellation transaction and preserves first failure; it does not execute Source or synthesize a second interpreter.
constructorWrites.qualification: Static/source and std-only production phase checks and changed C++ TU compilation remain separate from C++ IR semantic execution, whole admission, ordinary wire, Runtime/VM, resources and RF.

arrayCallAuthority.authority: Verify the complete existing fixed Published v5 context, ordered callable/signature/owner-parameter coverage, readonly ReadSpan grammar, returnOrigin and all contract/scope/publication identities against the owned semantic catalogue, source closure and exports. Self-consistent hashes or producer effect booleans alone grant no purity or source admission.
arrayCallAuthority.selectedCalls: Independently join every actual selected direct, method, construction and super call to its owned target and exact ordered SSA parameter operands. Publish structural operand evidence only after complete validation of the fixed table and all real call mappings. Keep every selected target upper even when its actual current body is empty.
arrayCallAuthority.unknown: A missing or empty table does not establish purity. Published local.structural retains an unknown-owner structural effect rather than a presumed fresh local allocation. Incomplete selected-call or external authority remains pending; malformed supplied authority is rejected.
arrayCallAuthority.transaction: Share the existing ModuleProof work budget, preserve first failure and stage all structural inputs, actual owner projections, per-call and per-definition completion until the same solve succeeds. Missing publication clears all four outputs. Contract-only success remains distinct from the unified whole-module gate.
arrayCallAuthority.qualification: Source/HIR producer checks and changed C++ API object compilation are distinct from semantic Core IR execution, admitted ordinary wire, Runtime/VM, resources and RF.
arrayCallAuthority.coverage: The same production bounded owner-relative effects engine consumes independently normalized actual SSA parameters, local allocations, view/ReadSpan edges, CFG operands, actual reads/writes/resizes, normal returns and every selected call. Check each function Effective effect against its fixed Published upper; a valid hash cannot hide an actual structural write. Independently proved existing-slot stores remain writes without a structural effect. An unproved owner/return/call dependency propagates pending and cannot publish complete or pure call evidence. Keep declared upper effects even when the current body is empty; do not infer a smaller contract.
arrayCallAuthority.completion: After the same production ArrayCallFlow solve, only independently proved definitions enter arrayCallDefinitionsComplete. When the fixed authority is provided, unified admission requires every actual owned definition, including exports without callsites, to have this completion evidence. Pending/empty maps never establish purity or successful return authority.

borrowStability.identity: Ordered ArrayFlow independently publishes actual SSA owner possibilities only after its equations complete. Carrier capacity, ABI resource directories and producer owner labels never directly seed borrow instance identity.
borrowStability.liveness: The production bounded BorrowFlow engine solves SSA live-in sets across actual feasible CFG edge occurrences. Each edge simultaneously substitutes its real successor block parameters. Distinct aliases and old loop-iteration values survive until their own last use; a new borrow definition never kills an earlier borrow merely because a family label matches.
borrowStability.effects: At an actual structural mutation, compare every live ReadSpan owner possibility with the independent actual affected owner possibilities and proved alias/separation relations. Unknown identity or sharing remains pending. Fixed Published call effects are consumed even when a selected body is empty; local structural upper affects unknown owners.
borrowStability.overwrite: An array_store may avoid a structural conflict only through an independently proved write-before query showing that the real same-index dense slot already exists, with complete source and bounds evidence. Existing-element overwrite is permitted; append, shrink, missing or unknown slot/alias/call state cannot use this exemption. Dynamic checked-store semantics and evaluation order remain unchanged.
borrowStability.transaction: Share the existing bounded proof work/cancellation transaction, validate malformed supplied inputs globally, preserve first failure and expose no successful evidence after failure. The IR adapter consumes the same production liveness engine tested without LLVM.
borrowStability.qualification: Necessary independent borrow/overwrite/call components remain development proof consumers. Object compilation and std-only engine execution do not establish full Core IR semantic execution, whole admission, canonical wire, Runtime/VM, ResourceProof or RF.
borrowStability.sameLengthResize: A proven actual no-change resize is exempt from a structural conflict through the denseLength proof below. This does not exempt a true or possibly unknown length change merely because capacity is sufficient.

returnOwners.equations: Reuse the same successful ArrayCallFlow IdentityOrigin solution for real SSA container owner projections, actual formal/local allocation roots, feasible CFG edge occurrences and selected-call argument substitution. Distinct actual allocation roots remain distinct; unknown/unproductive sources stay pending. No second owner solver or Published-instance seed is added.
returnOwners.consumer: Borrow instantiates those real roots through independently derived actualArrayOwners. A newly created ReadSpan is not the object identity of its Array parameter. Successful return lifetime requires all projected owner roots to remain within the allowed formal frame; unresolved stored/captured aggregate lifetime still fails.
returnOwners.qualification: The production std component and actual Source-to-HIR-to-finite text tests cover their own layers; IR semantic execution, actual whole-command admission, canonical wire and VM remain unqualified.

denseLength.authority: The actual IR backward query reconstructs successful dense lengths from real array_create operands, prior checked resize RHS and preceding stores. A carrier/Published resource capacity, producer nonStructural flag or static type never seeds an observed length.
denseLength.equations: The same production PayloadFlow MemoryVersion engine solves DenseLength equations. Literal overwrite preserves length, exactly-tail append increments it, gaps have no normal successful continuation, and an unresolved store propagates pending. Actual CFG predecessor edge occurrences substitute receiver parameters; pure selected-call continuations preserve state, possible modifying calls and unknown aliases invalidate it. Recursive or loop equations without a productive source remain pending.
denseLength.noChange: Only complete nonpending length evidence whose every possible alternative equals the current actual checked resize RHS can add that real operation to nonStructuralArrayEffects. Equal opaque SSA length values require independently complete native u32 payload identity. Existing-element overwrite evidence remains independently proved first.
denseLength.consumer: Borrow and fixed Published effect coverage consume the same independently completed nonStructuralArrayEffects set for proven no-change resize. A true shrink/append/unknown possible change remains structural; dynamic checked resize validation, evaluation order, range traps and actual storage behavior are unchanged.
denseLength.resource: The proof shares the existing bounded work and first-failure transaction. DenseLength has component cancellation support; the synchronous ModuleProof adapter still has no external cancellation hook. Stage no-change operations locally and publish only after complete success.
denseLength.qualification: Source facts/ordinary producer, same production std engine and changed TU API compilation are separate qualifications. This development contract does not establish actual Core IR semantic execution, ordinary wire, full view storage/return lifetime, Runtime/VM, resources or RF.

admission.entry: verifyCoreModule selects finite::verifyModule before legacy private-mode dispatch. The contract-only verifyModuleContracts API and full admission share one transaction-local validation pipeline; contract success alone is insufficient.
admission.identity: Bounded iterative discovery includes finite metadata, operation names and nested operand/result/block/attribute types. Discovery exhaustion routes to the finite reject path rather than falling through legacy modes. Whole admission requires the exact current Core0.12 identity, rejects mixed private candidate markers and preserves legitimate String operations.
admission.obligations: A successful transaction must have no unprovedMemoryReads or unprovedActualBounds, and all borrow checks must succeed. Provided authority must independently complete every actual function definition. Actual owner-bearing selected calls require independently published completion; absent maps never authorize purity. Checked external cell payload evidence does not replace independent source/bounds eligibility.
admission.publication: Only the complete transaction may return success to the ordinary Core verifier. No partial registry or proof object escapes failure. This hook does not itself encode/adopt typed wire, execute Source/VM or prove Runtime/resource/RF qualification.
admission.qualification: The actual C++ hook is implemented and API-object compiled. Core IR semantic execution and complete ordinary parse/print/wire/Runtime consumers still require separate evidence; current HOLD remains.

definitionAuthority.entries: Required canonical owned [{functionId,parameterBinding,viewType,origin,roots:[{sourceType,targetType}]}]. Order by owned FunctionId then BindingId; roots by owned sourceType then targetType. Every actual exported parameter has exactly one record, including native empty roots. Export aliases share one function ABI; source_exports retains the original names.
definitionAuthority.origin: Entry origin equals the original callable parameter origin exactly. Every root must reference an already checked M12 record at that same declaration origin. Expression-origin proofs cannot be promoted to entry authority. Reachable reference targets include payload union/container/value/nominal fields and effective method explicit parameters/returns; an inherited base or overridden method is not an extra payload leaf.
definitionAuthority.definition: Every nonexport callable parameter has one exact role seed; receiver parameters require owner plus real nominal descendants only. Ordinary parameters require declared concrete leaves, selected published entry references for that role, and incoming actual flows. Scalar/value identities remain exact seeds; scalar seeds do not discard additional actual absence propagated by real calls/as/aliases.
definitionAuthority.consumer: C++ ModuleContracts checks entry/published/definition roles, same-origin roots, all ordered parameter seed obligations and fixed Published Call Contract identity against actual function ABI. This is an independent necessary lower bound. Actual-flow upper-bound completeness/minimality, alias/resource state and remaining memory eligibility must still be discharged before unified admission; extra unproved variants are not authorized by this check.

localPending: valid undefined payload narrowed by pure as then consumed by native arithmetic: approved operation failure/coercion mapping absent
A genuinely unanalyzable external boundary or missing selected-producer entry authority remains local pending; ordinary exported parameters have compiler-derived finite bounds.
mixed representation field writes and construction object-return replacement need complete actual-field/receiver flow before ABI publication
